{{Current events|year=2023|month=02|day=7|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Health and environment'''
*[[Global spread of H5N1]]
**[[Ministry of Environment (Peru)|Peru's Ministry of Environment]] reports that the [[Influenza A virus subtype H5N1|H5N1]] [[influenza A virus]] has killed 585 [[sea lion]]s and more than 55,000 birds within [[List of protected areas of Peru|its protected areas]] in recent weeks. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/nearly-600-sea-lions-die-due-to-bird-flu-outbreak-in-peru-101675814124031.html (AFP via ''Hindustan Times'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 Brazilian Congress attack]]
**The [[Federal Police of Brazil|Federal Police]] arrest the [[Military Police (Brazil)|military police]] officer in charge of security during the January 8 attack against the [[Brazilian Congress]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/brazil-police-conduct-new-raids-part-probe-into-brasilia-riots-2023-02-07/ (Reuters)]
*[[Crime in Japan]]
**Two of four Japanese gang leaders based in the [[Philippines]] are [[deport]]ed on suspicion of ordering around 2,300 [[Robbery|robberies]] and [[phone fraud]] activities with a total value of {{JPY|3.5 billion|link=yes}} ({{USD|26.4 million|link=yes}}) in [[Japan]]. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/02/07/news/japanese-luffy-criminal-ringleadersdeported-from-philippines/1877605 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
*[[Munster Technological University ransomware attack]]
**[[Munster Technological University]] in the [[Republic of Ireland]] announces that it is investigating an incident involving its computer and telephone systems, saying that campuses in [[County Cork]] will be closed as a result. [https://www.rte.ie/news/munster/2023/0206/1354118-munster-university/ (RTÉ)]
*[[Nduga hostage crisis]]
**The [[Free Papua Movement]], led by Egianus Kogoya, burn a [[Susi Air]] plane and take 15 passengers hostage in Paro Airport, [[Nduga Regency]], [[Highland Papua]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://scnow.com/ap/international/separatist-rebels-take-new-zealand-pilot-hostage-in-papua/article_2d236a41-10a1-5284-98c8-5f3f5e3db931.html (SCNOW)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Solomon Islands protests]]
**Police use [[tear gas]] to disperse protesters after the governor of [[Malaita province]], [[Daniel Suidani]], is removed in a [[no-confidence vote]]. Suidani was one of the strongest critics of the government's approach to [[China]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/feb/07/protests-in-solomon-islands-as-key-china-critic-politician-is-ousted-in-no-confidence-vote (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2023 State of the Union Address]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] delivers the 2023 State of the Union address to the [[118th United States Congress]]. It was Biden's second [[State of the Union|State of the Union Address]], and his [[2021 Joe Biden speech to a joint session of Congress|third speech]] to a [[joint session of the United States Congress]]. [https://www.cnn.com/politics/live-news/biden-state-of-the-union-2023/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Politics of the United Kingdom]]
**[[2023 British cabinet reshuffle]]
***British Prime Minister [[Rishi Sunak]] carries out the first significant reshuffle of his majority government. The reshuffle filled the vacancy left by [[Nadhim Zahawi]] after he was dismissed as [[Chairman of the Conservative Party]] and [[Minister without Portfolio]] on 29 January 2023.[https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-64552127 (BBC News)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2022–23 NBA season]]
**During a regular-season game against the [[Oklahoma City Thunder]], [[LeBron James]] records his 38,388th career NBA point, surpassing [[Kareem Abdul-Jabbar]] as the [[List of National Basketball Association career scoring leaders|NBA all-time scoring leader]]. [https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/35611846/lakers-lebron-james-passes-kareem-abdul-jabbar-become-nba-all-scoring-leader (ESPN)]
